exposure: small birth size (as a proxy for low birthweight)
cohort: Neonates from rural and urban Nigeria from the 2013 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (n = 20,449 rural and 9,935 urban)
finding: Neonatal mortality rate was higher in rural (36 deaths per 1000 live births) vs. urban (28 deaths per 1000 live births) areas, and risk factors differed between settings.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a risk factor for neonatal mortality in both rural and urban Nigeria.
birth_weight: low birth weight (using small birth size as proxy)
